builds.name: Orb of Deception ceiling
builds.summary: Both outbound and returning orb hit once; maximize the paired AP packets. MR penetration affects outbound only; Shadowflame can affect eligible true return damage.
builds.goal: Both outbound and returning orb hit once; maximize the paired AP packets. MR penetration affects outbound only; Shadowflame can affect eligible true return damage.
builds.hypothesis:
Ahri throws then pulls back her orb, dealing [35 / 60 / 85 / 110 / 135 + (0.5) × AP] magic damage on the way out and [35 / 60 / 85 / 110 / 135 + (0.5) × AP] true damage on the way back.
Deathcap multiplies AP; Void Staff and Shadowflame reduce effective MR on magic packets, with Shadowflame low-health amplification tested. Zhonya/Banshee are high AP stat slots; Riftmaker is fully ramped before scoring. Mana variants use earned Seraph for mana-derived AP, read live; burn variants use Liandry ramp and Blackfire one-target AP buff, with proc damage separate. First Strike adds a separately measured initiation bonus; Absolute Focus supplies adaptive stat only above its health threshold; Gathering Storm is fixed to 30min. Cash Back/Biscuit/Cosmic are economy/sustain/utility, not assumed direct damage multipliers.

Return intersects target after first hit; do not add W/E/R. Log raw kit packet(s), post-mitigation damage and separate item/rune packets; repeat at 100% target HP and swap one item at a time. First Strike must be ready and champion initiates; compare eligible bonus separately.

Rune reasoning: Ahri — Orb of Deception: Use adaptive stats for the actual damage helper and a finisher matching the starting enemy/owner HP. The keystone proc is measured separately; damage type alone does not justify attack speed, crit, or an ultimate modifier. Ability basis: Ahri throws then pulls back her orb, dealing [35 / 60 / 85 / 110 / 135 + (0.5) × AP] magic damage on the way out and [35 / 60 / 85 / 110 / 135 + (0.5) × AP] true damage on the way back. Deathcap multiplies AP; Void Staff and Shadowflame reduce effective MR on Deathfire Touch: Burn is a separate packet with real refresh/ramp rules, not extra native ticks. Manaflow Band: Earned maximum mana/resource utility; only actual mana conversions can turn it into offensive stats. Absolute Focus: Adaptive stats only while owner stays above 70% HP (starts at 100%). Gathering Storm: Fixed minute-30 adaptive stats (or the authored time), never an infinite-time ceiling. Legend: Bloodline: Exactly15 earned stacks give85HP; equipped Riftmaker converts actual bonus HP into AP for this helper. No additional lifesteal damage or free stacks. Coup de Grace: Eligible non-true damage only below 40% victim HP; not active on a healthy first hit.

Stat shards: Offense adaptive force feeds only the actual AD/AP coefficient and uses real adaptive-type conversion. Flex adaptive force targets the stated AD/AP coefficient. Defense scaling health is 180 HP at level 18, rather than the old 65-HP shard.

Highest-number candidate, not proof of mathematical maximum. Use current stored source values and verify all conditional multipliers. Unlimited game time changes Gathering Storm; no finite global maximum over unrestricted time. Damage cannot exceed remaining HP as an observed health loss; record theoretical packet separately. Crit does not automatically multiply spells/pets/procs. Report observed damage only while the target survives; any theoretical full-window overkill is a separate raw-potential metric, not damage actually dealt.
tradeoffs: Six completed items assume late boots sell/swap; movement and practical survival/access are sacrificed for the number. Rabadon's Deathcap, Void Staff, Shadowflame, Seraph's Embrace, Banshee's Veil, Riftmaker. Required setup damage is excluded from scored ability. Defensive or attack-speed replacements may win real fights despite a lower isolated packet.
Confidence: plausible. This is a finite-condition ceiling candidate, not a solver-certified global maximum or a recommended match build.
buyOrder: This is a late six-item ceiling loadout. Compare individual item swaps at fixed level, earned stacks and target conditions; the displayed order is not a lane shopping order.
Keep boots and role starters during the actual game. A damage-slot boot replacement requires a deliberate late benchmark and may make the ability impossible to land.

builds.name: Fox-Fire: three fires on one victim
builds.summary: Investigate high one three-fire Fox-Fire volley on one champion output under a finite setup; compare controlled item swaps instead of claiming a global maximum.
builds.goal: Investigate high one three-fire Fox-Fire volley on one champion output under a finite setup; compare controlled item swaps instead of claiming a global maximum.
builds.hypothesis: Each first fire deals 40/60/80/100/120 + 0.4 AP magic, with subsequent hits reduced to 40%. Three fires on the same victim nominally weight 1 + 0.4 + 0.4 = 1.8 full fires, giving rank-5 total 216 + 0.72 AP. Movement speed is utility, not another damage multiplier.
